title: Lookup: search by name, then fetch by server and character id
body: GET api-search.plaync.com/aion2global/search/v2/character?keyword=&region=&localeInfo= (optional serverId) returns characterId, serverId, pcId, level. Both params required: 400 without localeInfo.

title: Character info: profile, stats, item level, titles, Daevanion
body: GET aion2.plaync.com/api/character/info?region=&lang=&characterId=&serverId=. profile has name, className, characterLevel, combatPower, serverName; item level is the stat row of type ItemLevel. 404 without region.

title: Character equipment: gear, skills with levels, stigmas
body: GET aion2.plaync.com/api/character/equipment, same params. skill.skillList has every class skill: category Active, Passive or Dp (stigma), skillLevel, acquired, equip. Stigmas carry no slot position.

title: No auth, no cookies, no rate-limit headers seen
body: Plain curl with its default User-Agent gets 200 and no Set-Cookie. 20 back-to-back info calls all answered 200; responses are no-store, live calls take about 1.8 s and repeats inside a few seconds about 0.24 s.

title: Errors: unknown id, wrong server and missing region are all 404
body: info answers 404 application/problem+json with code resource.not_found for a wrong serverId, an unknown characterId and a missing region alike, so a 404 does not say which.

title: Terms of Use forbid automated access outside published interfaces
body: NC's Terms § 6, linked from the profile page's footer, bar automated access other than published interfaces, and scraping without consent. The character endpoints are unpublished; a scheduled fetch runs against that.

title: NC's published Open API has no Aion 2 character data
body: The NC OPEN API at developers.plaync.com documents Lineage 2M market data only, needs a key, and forbids caching its data; /apis/aion2 lands on an error page. Nothing published covers Aion 2, global or KR.

title: Name search is case-insensitive: match case-sensitively, by server
body: The search returns substring matches in any case with <strong> markup ("BAon" for "Baon"). Strip the markup, keep the configured serverId, compare the name exactly; info accepts the id with %3D or =.

title: Fan armory: no public API
body: metabot.gg reads the same official data and refreshes a copy older than 30 minutes, but its /api/ is disallowed in robots.txt, answers curl with 403 and has no developer page.
